title: Method and system for aggregating coding fields of multi-party gradients in federated learning

pse.problem: The existing federated learning process introduces computational cost and communication burden due to the use of homomorphic encryption.
pse.solution_function: The invention provides a coding domain aggregation method that encodes gradients from multiple participating terminals, aggregates them on the server, decodes them back to obtain a decoding gradient, and updates the federated learning model.
pse.solution_structure: Multiple participating terminals have their own data sets. There is a server with an encoder, decoder, and quantization parameters. A training data set is generated according to the quantization parameters.
pse.solution_implementation: Participating terminals calculate original gradients based on neural network, quantize them, map to an integer domain, and input into the pre-trained encoder. The server initializes the encoder, decoder, and quantization parameters; samples vectors from the training data set; trains and updates the encoder; aggregates all coding gradients; inputs the aggregation result into a pre-trained decoder to obtain a decoding gradient.
pse.effect: The invention reduces computational cost and communication burden in comparison to existing federated learning methods that use homomorphic encryption.
